body:
This is refreshing and might be the most promising looking LLM PR that anyone has sent us and it fits quite well with the current release. It seems _reasonable_, but still has some way to go. I've posted comments on some changes, some questions that needs investigation and some missing parts. 

One part that is going to be tricky is to "get it correct". This does require some extended testing and actually running nodes agents Tailscale SaaS to validate that we have the same behaviour so we do not have to make breaking changes in the future.

In addition, as mentioned in the comment about taildrive, peer relay and so on, we need to align all of these into the new support and that does mean we are making a breaking change as internal behaviour is changing and it will require users to explicitly enable the ones of these that are not new in the 0.29 release. Changelog must be updated. 

Please be mindful when you are steering the next LLM session and dont blindly ask it to "fix all my comments". LLMs work well when you steer them.
